additional_info.subject: Issue Description
additional_info.body:
Hello , The terminal on this charger is no longer working. The
logs displays the following error: "Terminal candidate list empty."
I also haven’t seen any transactions for quite some time. Based on
similar cases we have encountered in the past, this is often due to
a faulty CORA10.
I have attached photos showing the error on the logs,
Could you please confirm if the CORA10 is indeed the cause? And if
so, can we proceed with its replacement?
Thank you for your support.
Best regards,
